'''Dewlannamapia''' was a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] who attended the dedication of a memorial portrait to the late [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] at the end of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].

==Behind the scenes==
A Dewlannamapia appears in [[James Luceno]]'s ''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]'', the final novel of [[Star Wars: The New Jedi Order|''The New Jedi Order'']] series, attending the memorial to the late Chewbacca. Dewlannamapia was the name of the Wookiee who raised [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] as established in ''[[The Paradise Snare]]''. However, as the novel is set [[29 ABY/Legends|thirty-nine years]] after Dewlannamapia's death, the Wookiee in ''The Unifying Force'' must be another individual.
